dex.entry: Lumpin's shell has fused into a radiant broad disc; it now clings to sea-cliff faces and projects a beam of moonlit brine-light that disrupts approaching attackers. A gorgeous, bizarre disc-creature — its single-eye silhouette is instantly iconic.

art.silhouette: Wide flat disc-shell patterned with concentric gold-and-aqua rings, textured like hammered moonstone. The creature beneath is plump and soft-looking with a single large circular eye at the shell's centre aperture.
